delta_definition: WMSE(model) - WMSE(Mean), paired by fold and condition; negative favors model

auxiliary_references_excluded.reason: Absent from verified 8369-gene full5 scores; legacy author_formal scores on a different/native gene axis cannot be paired with this common-axis Mean. No rescoring performed.

center: perturbation-equal arithmetic mean of paired WMSE differences

bootstrap.unit: perturbation (fold, condition), pooled across five folds
bootstrap.sampling: n=1802 pairs with replacement; canonical fold/condition sort; NumPy default_rng reset seed per model
bootstrap.caveat: No fold clustering; CI describes perturbation variability, not independent training replicates.

significance.test: two-sided paired t-test, implemented as one-sample t-test of model-minus-Mean differences against zero
significance.mean_reference: zero by construction; no test or bootstrap

protocol_caveats: Five held-out folds from current GEARS sidecars; approximately 70:10:20 train/validation/test, not exact author 69:11:20 protocol.
Shared fitted models induce dependence among perturbations; t-test and nonclustered bootstrap retain the original descriptive comparison convention.
Fixed-common scores differ from native coverage; this is not a formal significance comparison with published paper values.
score_provenance: Stage1 per-condition scores reused after full5 audit/hash/axis checks; full5 fixed-common PRESAGE per-condition scores; all nine WMSE means checked against nine_methods_18metrics.csv.
adaptation: structural adaptation of existing forest script; original script preserved; mixed-axis legacy auxiliary joins removed
figure_contract: Single quantitative comparison panel; 183 mm width, direct labels, editable PDF/SVG text; 300 dpi blog PNG.

accepted_warnings: PNG-only raster at 300 dpi is deliberate for blog delivery; PDF and SVG vector exports are also available on GPU.
Random-generator warning is a false positive for the required bootstrap; all plotted scores are real fixed-common evaluations.
qa.visual_review: Rendered 1992x1335 PNG inspected: all nine row labels, n labels, confidence intervals, P/t annotations, zero reference, and protocol footnotes visible without clipping or overlaps.
